sources.title: Immigration New Zealand — Research starting point, not verified

open_questions: This demo has not checked official requirements. Check official sources before using it for a real application.
What are the school, course, duration and expected start date?
Current immigration status and the applicable visa route need to be checked.

tasks.title: Confirm school and course
tasks.details: Confirm the school, course and expected start date. Research the school’s official admissions guidance. This task is a preparation recommendation.

tasks.title: Verify the applicable visa and official requirements
tasks.details: Check official sources for the route that applies to the applicant’s nationality, country of residence, age, course and duration. Required evidence and visa eligibility have not yet been verified.

tasks.title: Plan arrival preparations
tasks.details: Once admissions dates and visa conditions are confirmed, plan accommodation, transport and other preparations. Do not buy tickets or make bookings.
